body.text: up late with trey songz, passion, pain & pleasure playing. man, i gotta go back and really sit with this album.
music has a way of doing that. one song and you're right back in a certain room, a certain year, with a certain person. memories, people, whole chapters of your life pulled back into focus.
and lately the person that keeps coming back into focus is her.

i've known her for 10 years. she's been there through different seasons of my life, through growth, through distance, through change + everything in between. we weren't always in the same place at the same time. but somehow the thread never fully broke.
with 2026 coming to an end, i'm realizing how differently i see love, connection + companionship at 30.
at 20, love felt like something you needed. something to fill the quiet, prove you were wanted, or patch up whatever you hadn't figured out about yourself yet.
at 30, it feels like a choice.

and it hits different when you choose someone because you're whole, not because you need someone to fill a void. you're not looking for a rescue. you're looking for a partner. somebody to build with, grow with, and actually enjoy the life you've been working to create.

we've both lived. we've both learned. we've both grown. and sometimes life brings things back around once you're finally in the headspace to appreciate them. not because the timing was wrong before, but because you were.
i used to think keeping things quiet was the mature move. don't post, don't explain, let people wonder.

what i'm protecting is the connection, not her from being seen. there's a difference between guarding what y'all have and hiding who you have. one is wisdom. the other is just fear wearing a nice outfit.
so i'm not hiding this one.
i'm proud of her. i'm proud of us. and i want the world to know she's mine and i'm hers.
